new_claim.statement: For an invertible indefinite original-coordinate physical pair B, if the exact Schur complement admits an original-coordinate partition I,J,K with zero I-self block and at least two nonzero cross singular values between I and J, then the pair-log singularity is paid by the partner top-d cross density cap. With D=|det B|, kappa=sigma_min(B), H_*=min_d c_d(prod_{j<=d}s_j)^(-1/d), eta=8DH_*/kappa, the density cap is 6[H_*/(kappa sqrt(D))]^(1/3) for eta<=1 and D^(-1/2)[3+log eta] for eta>=1.

localization_lemma: If conditional interval caps are H(W), then the unconditional density cap is at most E H(W); fragment decompositions therefore pay only the mass-weighted sum of normalized caps, with no support-radius or fragment-count tax.
